summary: Osisko Gold Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release disclosing a formal board construction decision for its 100%-owned Cariboo Gold Project in central British Columbia. The release cites a US$30 million strategic private placement from a Trafigura affiliate, concentrate and doré off-take with Trafigura, and a potential prepayment facility up to US$120 million. Go-forward capital obligation is $990 million against up to $1,637 million of available and proposed sources, including $837 million cash equivalents. Project completion is 22% as of July 31, 2026, first gold pour Q1 2029.
